{/* Header */}

App Contracts

Define your application's contract with the Portal framework

{/* Main Content */}
{/* Overview Section */}

Overview

The app.contract.ts file defines the configuration contract for your Portal application. It specifies metadata, SEO settings, conversion tracking, policies, and quality gates that govern your app's behavior and presentation.

Location: src/app.contract.ts

{/* Full Example */}

Full Example 

{`// src/app.contract.ts
import { AppContract } from "@portal/core";

export const contract: AppContract = {
  name: "Portal App",
  brand: {
    logo: "https://example.com/logo.png",
    primaryColor: "#3B82F6",
    accentColor: "#10B981",
    fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif"
  },
  seo: {
    title: "AI Support Assistant | My Company",
    description: "24/7 AI-powered customer support",
    keywords: ["support", "ai", "assistant"],
    ogImage: "https://example.com/og.png"
  },
  conversion: {
    trackingId: "GA-123456789",
    events: [
      { name: "message_sent", value: 1 },
      { name: "issue_resolved", value: 10 }
    ]
  },
  policies: {
    dataRetention: 90,
    privacyUrl: "https://example.com/privacy",
    termsUrl: "https://example.com/terms",
    cookieConsent: true
  },
  qualityGates: {
    minConfidence: 0.85,
    maxResponseTime: 3000,
    fallbackMessage: "Let me connect you with a human agent.",
    reviewThreshold: 0.6
  }
};`}
{/* Contract Fields */}

Contract Fields

{/* Name Field */}

name

The unique identifier and display name for your application. Used throughout the Portal framework for logging, analytics, and UI display. 

{`name: "My Support Assistant"`}

Type: string

Required: Yes

Max Length: 100 characters

{/* Brand Field */}

brand

Brand configuration including logo, colors, and visual identity. Controls the appearance of your app across Portal interfaces. 

{`brand: {
  logo: "https://example.com/logo.png",
  primaryColor: "#3B82F6",
  accentColor: "#10B981",
  fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif"
}`}

Type: BrandConfig

Properties:

  • logo - URL to brand logo
  • primaryColor - Hex color code
  • accentColor - Secondary color
  • fontFamily - CSS font stack
{/* SEO Field */}

seo

Search engine optimization metadata. Improves discoverability and controls how your app appears in search results and social sharing. 

{`seo: {
  title: "AI Support Assistant | My Company",
  description: "24/7 AI-powered customer support",
  keywords: ["support", "ai", "assistant"],
  ogImage: "https://example.com/og.png"
}`}

Type: SEOConfig

Properties:

  • title - Page title (50-60 chars)
  • description - Meta description (150-160 chars)
  • keywords - Array of keywords
  • ogImage - Open Graph image URL
{/* Conversion Field */}

conversion

Conversion tracking configuration. Defines events and goals that measure user engagement and business outcomes. 

{`conversion: {
  trackingId: "GA-123456789",
  events: [
    { name: "message_sent", value: 1 },
    { name: "issue_resolved", value: 10 }
  ]
}`}

Type: ConversionConfig

Properties:

  • trackingId - Analytics provider ID
  • events - Array of conversion events
  • events[].name - Event identifier
  • events[].value - Conversion value
{/* Policies Field */}

policies

Legal and compliance policies. Defines data retention, privacy, terms, and consent requirements for your application. 

{`policies: {
  dataRetention: 90,
  privacyUrl: "https://example.com/privacy",
  termsUrl: "https://example.com/terms",
  cookieConsent: true
}`}

Type: PoliciesConfig

Properties:

  • dataRetention - Days to retain data
  • privacyUrl - Link to privacy policy
  • termsUrl - Link to terms of service
  • cookieConsent - Enable cookie consent banner
{/* Quality Gates Field */}

qualityGates

Quality assurance thresholds. Controls AI response confidence, response time limits, and fallback behavior when quality standards are not met. 

{`qualityGates: {
  minConfidence: 0.85,
  maxResponseTime: 3000,
  fallbackMessage: "Let me connect you with a human agent.",
  reviewThreshold: 0.6
}`}

Type: QualityGatesConfig

Properties:

  • minConfidence - Minimum AI confidence score (0-1)
  • maxResponseTime - Max response time in ms
  • fallbackMessage - Message when confidence is low
  • reviewThreshold - Score below which human review is triggered
